sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Ứng dụng bản đồ của tôi không hoạt động names the problem so staff or a helpful local can act on it. Use it when My map app is not working is the clearest way to explain what changed, went missing, or needs attention.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Say Ứng dụng bản đồ của tôi không hoạt động calmly and show the proof if you have it: map, address, ride screen, sign, or nearby landmark. After that, let the other person ask one follow-up or point you to the right next step.

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Use this as soon as the problem is clear enough to name. It is especially useful at a counter or desk where someone can look at the photo, receipt, bag, booking, or phone screen with you.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Keep the explanation simple and show the evidence if you can. A short phrase plus a photo, receipt, or booking usually works better than adding more English.
